title: Sandokai Part 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up "Merging of Difference and Unity," Shitou's poem in the chant book, as part of a year of talks on the book's short texts. Nomon introduces Shitou as a student of Huineng who lived in a hut on a boulder and received the Dharma name "stone head," then reads the first half of the poem line by line. Light and dark, branching streams, and the senses come alive through tree-gazing, where the tree is you and still keeps its place, and through Nomon's delight at seeing Nomon's own eyebrows for the first time. After small groups of three share what the lines stir up, Nomon closes on the poem's last line, "Don't waste your time in vain," and wonders whether the laughter in the room comes from the darkness or the light.
